decision.reason: Withhold after independent risk audit (metadata-only): Both Malay answers correctly express ‘give permission’. However, the national contrast is overstated: membolehkan is also common in both varieties, and membenarkan has additional meanings such as ‘confirm’ or ‘agree’. Add a learner-facing contrast and qualify the relation as a common-preference difference rather than an exclusive national split. Retain outside promotion pending a vetted correction and fresh current clearance.
